newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER STAR KLUIVERT TO ESCAPE RAPE CHARGE - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER STAR KLUIVERT TO ESCAPE RAPE CHARGE - PAPER.

text.p: Dutch soccer star Patrick Kluivert will not be prosecuted over an accusation of rape brought against him last month, Dutch daily De Telegraaf said on Friday.
The paper said an Amsterdam court had decided not to proceed with the case due to lack of evidence and would announce its decision later on Friday.
The Amsterdam public prosecutors office was not immediately available for comment on the report.
Amsterdam police confirmed in June that they were investigating rape charges made against the Dutch international striker and three friends by a 20-year-old woman.
The charges against the three others would also be dismissed, the paper said.
Kluivert, 20, in February signed a four-year deal to move from Ajax Amsterdam to AC Milan.
In May last year he was convicted of causing death by dangerous driving. He was ordered to perform 240 hours of community service and received a three month jail sentence, suspended for two years.
